efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: Isa Sharrocks
negative_reviews.text: Ordered 2 chicken ramen + rainbow sushi roll, watched about 4 tables who came after us get their food. took 30 min until it turned out we was told our order wasnt put through, reordered and waited another 10/15 min until it came. Was got told we'd get a discount for such a long wait only for it to turn out its the 10% off that we would've already have gotten for NHS discount...food was alright, staff friendly.

Per-site star tabs NOT used (corrupt). Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source). Cumulative venue rating not in this source (null). Built 2026-11-03.
